key_insight: An agent-assisted experimental workflow can be transferred and refined across different quantum processors to complete the same task reliably despite device-specific differences and drift.
engineering_relevance: This shows a practical path toward scalable quantum lab automation, reducing dependence on expert-driven, device-specific tuning for repeated experiments.
method: Developed the strategy on one three-qubit NMR processor.
Sequentially deployed it on four other processors with operator support for preparation and interventions.
Used the agent to assess evidence, choose measurements, and adapt procedures during Grover state preparation.
evidence_signal: Across four deployments, the reconstructed dominant eigenstates achieved marked-state populations from 0.910 to 0.959, staying within 3.8% of the ideal 0.945.
watch_item: The approach still depends on human operators for instrument preparation and physical intervention, so full autonomy was not demonstrated.
paper_title: Agent-assisted experimental strategy transfer across quantum processors
